standard_prerequisites.use: Produces a closed quasi-compact neighbourhood inside the given one.

standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that a closed subset of a quasi-compact set is quasi-compact
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the end of the counted proof (source lines 2255-2256)

core_obligations: One direction is the definition, so assume every point has a quasi-compact neighbourhood and let one be given (proof lines 2244-2246)

Refine inside an open neighbourhood: the quasi-compact neighbourhood is closed, its intersection complement with the given open neighbourhood is closed and misses the point, so disjoint opens separate the point from it (proof lines 2247-2254)

Conclusion: the closure of the neighbourhood of the point chosen in that separation is closed, quasi-compact and contained in the given open neighbourhood, so the quasi-compact neighbourhoods form a fundamental system (proof lines 2255-2257)
proof_roadmap: 反向：设每点有准紧邻域 E（Hausdorff ⇒ E 闭）。
给定开邻域 U ∋ x，则 Z = E ∖ U 是 E 的闭子集且不含 x ⇒ 由 E 中「点与闭集可用不交开集分离」取 W, V ⊂ E 分离 Z 与 x。
闭包(V) ⊂ E 是 x 的闭邻域且含于 E ∩ U；它是 E 的闭子集 ⇒ 准紧 ⇒ 得基本邻域系。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a Hausdorff space is locally quasi-compact exactly when every point admits a quasi-compact neighbourhood (author lemma at source lines 2238-2242, label lemma-locally-quasi-compact-Hausdorff). The proof (source lines 2244-2258) starts from a quasi-compact neighbourhood, separates a point from the part of it outside a given open neighbourhood and takes the closure of the separating open set, which is closed, quasi-compact and contained in the given neighbourhood (proof lines 2244-2257). The separation and closure step is the substance. H3.
